title: 1912 Prairie Avenue — the Moulton house built from its photograph
items: The Moulton/Lowden house at 1912 Prairie, a generic draft block until now, stands as the stone Chateauesque house of its photograph and the 1883 New Chicago Album: two storeys and an attic storey over a raised basement under a very steep slate roof with iron cresting.

A round tower rises three stages to a slated cone and finial between a coped gable over an arched pair of windows and the north corner block, whose door stands at the head of a high stoop between solid stone cheek walls; a tall stone chimney rises off the north side.
